poc_summary: Crafted a minimal ProRes RAW ('prrf') bitstream (250 bytes, /poc/input.bin) with width=130, height=16, version=0 (tile width 128px, tile height 16px). This yields 9 horizontal tiles (nb_tw=9); tile index 1 sits at x=128, leaving only 2px of visible width (130-128=2 < 16). In decode_comp(), w = FFMIN(128,2)/2 = 1, nb_blocks = 1/8 = 0, so log2_nb_blocks = 31 - ff_clz(0) is UB and the following `(1 << log2_nb_blocks) - 1` becomes an undefined/negative shift. Verified via run_poc on all three versions: each command recompiles the version's own unmodified libavcodec/prores_raw.c with -fsanitize=address,undefined (the cached target build only had ASan, not UBSan), relinks it into that version's own libavcodec.a, and runs a tiny custom harness (/poc/poc.c) that calls avcodec_find_decoder(AV_CODEC_ID_PRORES_RAW)/avcodec_open2/avcodec_send_packet directly on the byte-identical crafted packet.
explanation: post_intro (589b3ed943d4, the commit that adds the entire ProRes RAW decoder including prores_raw.c) crashes deterministically with exactly the reported defect: `libavcodec/prores_raw.c:143:31: runtime error: shift exponent -1 is negative` at `const int block_mask = (1 << log2_nb_blocks) - 1;` inside decode_comp(), reached via decode_tile -> decode_tiles -> avcodec_default_execute2 -> decode_frame — matching the OSS-Fuzz reported crash stack (decode_comp/decode_tiles/avcodec_default_execute2) and crash type (Undefined-shift) exactly. pre_intro (5674879db5ea) has no prores_raw.c at all (only prores_raw_parser.c exists there; AV_CODEC_ID_PRORES_RAW is a declared enum value but no decoder is registered), so avcodec_find_decoder() returns NULL and the harness exits cleanly printing 'no decoder' — the flaw cannot manifest because the feature containing it doesn't exist yet, confirming the bug was introduced exactly at 589b3ed943d4. post_benign, rebuilt the same way and run on the identical input, completes cleanly (exit=0, no sanitizer report); avcodec_send_packet instead returns an AVERROR (invalid data), because that source now contains the validation `if (avctx->width - tile->x < 16) return AVERROR_INVALIDDATA;` added to the per-tile offset-parsing loop (confirmed present in post_benign and absent in post_intro by direct grep), matching exactly what the real fix commit be1fd6d9d4b1 ("Tiles of width less than 16 result in undefined behavior") does. All three runs used the identical crafted input.bin via run_poc, isolating the observed sanitizer/behavior difference to the labelled code change.

oracle.description: Sanitizer-based oracle: recompiled the target's own unmodified prores_raw.c per revision with -fsanitize=address,undefined (the cached target build used ASan only) and ran a minimal direct-decoder harness on an identical crafted 'prrf' packet engineered so the rightmost tile's visible width (2px) falls under the 16px minimum assumed by decode_comp's block-count/log2 computation.
oracle.target_evidence: post_intro stack via run_poc: #0 decode_comp libavcodec/prores_raw.c:143:31, #1 decode_tile prores_raw.c:278, #2 decode_tiles prores_raw.c:311, #3 avcodec_default_execute2, #4 decode_frame prores_raw.c:482 — matches OSS-Fuzz reported Crash State (decode_comp/decode_tiles/avcodec_default_execute2) and Crash Type Undefined-shift. Source grep confirms `if (avctx->width - tile->x < 16) return AVERROR_INVALIDDATA;` is present in post_benign and absent in post_intro, matching fix commit be1fd6d9d4b1's stated purpose.

post_intro.command:
bash -c '
set -e
cd /work
if [ -f libavcodec/prores_raw.c ]; then
  clang -I. -I./ -D_ISOC11_SOURCE -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 -D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200112 -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=600 -DPIC -I./compat/stdbit -DZLIB_CONST -DHAVE_AV_CONFIG_H -DBUILDING_avcodec -g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -std=c17 -fPIC -pthread -g -Wno-parentheses -fno-math-errno -fno-signed-zeros -mstack-alignment=16 -Qunused-arguments -c -o /tmp/prores_raw_ubsan.o libavcodec/prores_raw.c
  cp /work/libavcodec/libavcodec.a /tmp/libavcodec_test.a
  ar d /tmp/libavcodec_test.a prores_raw.o
  EXTRA_OBJ=/tmp/prores_raw_ubsan.o
  ARC=/tmp/libavcodec_test.a
else
  EXTRA_OBJ=
  ARC=/work/libavcodec/libavcodec.a
fi
cp /poc/poc.c /tmp/poc.c
clang -g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I/work -DHAVE_AV_CONFIG_H -o /tmp/poc /tmp/poc.c $EXTRA_OBJ $ARC /work/libavformat/libavformat.a /work/libavutil/libavutil.a /work/libswresample/libswresample.a -lm -lpthread -lz
/tmp/poc /poc/input.bin
echo RUN_EXIT=$?
'
